business.description: Gandhi Special Tubes Limited manufactures seamless steel tubes, high-pressure tubes, welded tubes, and cold-formed coupling nuts, primarily supplying OEMs in automotive, commercial vehicles, farm equipment, construction equipment, and general engineering industries.

outlook.statement: Commercial vehicle industry expected to sustain growth trajectory in FY2026-27 at a more moderate pace; tractor demand resilient due to strong rural cashflows, higher MSPs, favourable farm credit despite below-normal monsoon forecast (90-92% of LPA); India's consumption-led growth story expected to remain resilient with RBI projecting 6.9% real GDP growth for FY2026-27

Company will focus on cost leadership and value engineering, efficient supply chain management, customer-centric product strategy, sustaining profitable growth, strengthening domestic leadership and expanding presence in global markets
